name: Bori Andon
description: A reckless Izzet guildmage and blastseeker on Ravnica, wanted by the Azorius.

timeline.summary: Bori launched a viashino through the Harmony Basilica window and his Ossmorpher disintegrated the Veil Theatre.
timeline.quote: Bori launched a viashino through the priceless stained-glass window at the Harmony Basilica

citation.text: "Bori Andon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Izmagnus Vay protected Bori and halted his projects, assigning him the Theorem of Simultaneous Discordance.
timeline.quote: the council halted Bori's projects and instead gave him a special task

citation.text: "Bori Andon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bori visited his friend Zaba, who gave him the route between the seven towers.
timeline.quote: Bori first visited his friend, the mapmaker Zaba

citation.text: "Bori Andon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bori's cyclone damaged the Dome of the Black Dove and a mass mind attack revealed Dimir conduits.
timeline.quote: He set off a cyclone that damaged the Dome of the Black Dove

citation.text: "Bori Andon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bori exploded the Dimir conduits and the dome crumbled; a vampire enforcer caught him but he escaped, and the Dimir decided to use his skills.
timeline.quote: the Dimir reassessed Bori's capabilities and decided to turn his skills to their cause instead of killing him outright

citation.text: "Bori Andon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bori activated all seven bells at once, solving the Theorem.
timeline.quote: finally managed to activate all seven bells at once using his device

citation.text: "Bori Andon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bori received a standing ovation and a tiny silver bell that would let the Dimir manipulate his mind.
timeline.quote: he received a standing ovation for having solved the Theorem
